visual_summary: A somber funeral-like aftermath unfolds in a dim, damaged interior. A close-up of a long-haired man accompanies narration about a warrior fighting to the end. A body lies on a raised slab in the background while armored debris and weapons litter the foreground. Another long-haired man kneels beside his injured son, whose legs are bandaged, tending to him. The son weeps, then embraces his father and asks forgiveness, while the father remains stern and emotionally restrained.
